assumptions: No amount is approved until StegFinCo validates applicant identity, personnel, rates, indirect-cost basis and sponsor allowability.
The final budget must include required experiential or I-Corps for PESOSE activities when mandated by the solicitation.
Subawards, consultants, participant support and travel require named scope and allowability review.
Unverified salaries, fringe rates and indirect-cost rates are not embedded in this request.
